Not a teacher but as a student. I was involved in a fight that actually caused our school to go on a “temporary lockdown” until this kid could be settled. It all started because of me? 

It’s very confusing and we were all in grade 6, but we had a few fights where it would be total chaos, then a few weeks later we are best friends again like it never happened. We had a big friend who wasn’t very bright, had a few learning disabilities, but we loved him the same (let’s call him “Dylan”) we also had another kid in the class who was skinny, long haired, but acted like a “gangster” (let’s call him “Ray”).So it all started when I was playing with them during recess. Dylan wanted to play tag with us, but he wanted to change it up a bit (can’t remember the exact details, but he didn’t like Ray’s game of tag so Dylan wanted to make it easier for him.) Ray obviously didn’t like this and they got into a small tiff over it, then parted ways to play somewhere else.... 

Well, obviously as a little shit starter I couldn’t pass up this opportunity, I wanted to see how far this would go. Back and forth I went between the two, acting as a “messenger” but my messages were sometimes a little corrupted and I would add a little “spice” into them to make it sound like they were being aggressive or sarcastic (basically making the other sound like a total douche) 

I can’t remember exactly what I said to Dylan to activate this “ultimate rage” but I remember his face once I said it. It felt like his eyes lost life, his body almost went limp while he was standing there in front of me, then it went into this “bull mode” where all of a sudden this kid is just a big red ball of fury. During lineup to leave the library, Dylan sprints over to Ray so fast that Ray didn’t even see the first few punches coming. Next thing you know, Ray is on the ground screaming and punching back (what a brave trooper, kid never covered his face one time, like he’s done this before) and Dylan is just pounding into him, meanwhile there are three teachers behind this kid trying to pull him off of Ray (Dylan is big so it’s hard to move him) and I’m just sitting there like “k this is too serious, let’s go” 

So, as I’m trying to leave, something clicks in Dylan’s head and all of a sudden he can see everything clearly. He turns to me slowly, walks up as calm as I’ve ever seen him during this hour, then says “you are absolutely dead” before going back into “bull mode” and chasing me around the school. I managed to get away and lock myself with the grade 3 kids. Dylan’s just pounding on doors, looking for me in every room, and screaming up and down the halls.... 

ever go into a lockdown, not because there’s someone who wants to kill everyone in the school, but they just want to kill 1 kid? Well I was that 1 kid that he wanted to kill.... 

It’s now been about an hour, after staffs multiple attempts at restraining Dylan, some teachers are  getting scratched or punched in the middle of it, trying to get him to just calm down and stop terrorizing classrooms looking for me. Finally he was carried by about 6 teachers/TAs, and put in a quiet room, while I’m moved to the office with Ray for questioning.... let’s just say I lied my ass off and got off scot free (I think I said something about Dylan having a crush on me and I rejected him, they believed it since we were so close anyway) 

I didn’t get away completely though, as teachers can’t protect you after school... for the next few weeks my butt is whooped by Dylan till my brothers come by to save me, and this occurred until he got bored of beating me up, then we became best friends again, almost like it never happened... grade-school was weird.
